problems.explain: The pole is opposite the sun's angle at the shadow's tip, and the shadow is adjacent: tan θ = 45/61. θ = tan⁻¹(45/61) ≈ 36.4164°, 36° to the nearest degree. (tan⁻¹(61/45) is the angle at the top of the pole.) So 36°.
